scientific_integrity: Exact renewal-reward and hyperbolic-function analysis; 116 auxiliary numerical assertions; no assertion of independent proof certification or authorship.
scientific_limitations: Free Brownian excursions, fixed deterministic post-capture delay, ideal instantaneous nearest-basin capture only; no finite-potential or non-Poisson universality. The no-delay current is from Roberts et al. 2024; sharp uniqueness and refractory crossovers are the assessed additions. Independent priority audit has not been performed.
title: Unique optimal local-ratchet resetting rate and a refractory crossover in near-perfect asymmetry
